title: How the data center backlash is growing in U.S. statehouses
description: Legislation is being introduced at a record pace as growing public opposition to data centers drives more proposals to restrict the tech giants.

title: Republicans court debate on expanding the Supreme Court
description: In recent years, Democrats have fumed over how Republicans have handled Supreme Court nominations.

title: Republicans fear Trump will keep super PAC money and not spend on the midterms
description: President Donald Trump has kept most of his super PAC money on the sidelines and been reticent on his spending plans, worrying Republicans ahead of this fall’s elections.

title: Secret Service is getting the fortified White House that past presidents resisted
description: President Donald Trump has backed plans including permanently fencing Lafayette Square that were previously rejected to maintain public access to the “People’s House.”

title: He tried to eliminate FEMA. Now he says the Trump administration has changed course
description: David Richardson worked to eliminate the country's top disaster agency when he led FEMA last year. Now, he says the administration has abandoned that goal.

title: Democrats demand Homeland Security officials fund election security ahead of midterms
description: The lawmakers wrote that they share "grave concern that time is running out … to assist state and local election officials in protecting our elections from cyber and mis-and disinformation threats."

title: Veteran political journalist on division among Democrats over Democratic Socialism
description: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with CNN senior political analyst Ron Brownstein about the Democratic Party's division over embracing Democratic Socialism.

title: Ex-National Security Council director on administration's plan for Venezuela oil
description: NPR's Michel Martin asks former Obama administration official Benjamin Gedan {guh-DAN} about the viability of the Trump administration's plan for Venezuelan oil.

title: Maduro seeks to fend off narco-terrorism trial, arguing he has immunity
description: Deposed Venezuelan leader Nicolás Maduro launched a sweeping attack on the U.S. criminal case against him, urging a judge to dismiss the charges as an an unlawful effort to prosecute a foreign head of state.

title: Trump encouraged Army secretary to stay in job
description: The president suggested to Dan Driscoll, who clashed with the defense secretary, that he could stay through the midterms, people familiar with the matter said.

title: FAA wants to permanently restrict planes over Mar-a-Lago, long a Trump complaint
description: The rules would affect flights traveling into and out of the nearby airport recently renamed after the president.

title: Plane carrying DHS Secretary Mullin makes emergency landing after engine failure
description: The pilot told air traffic controllers in the Washington area that the airplane had 14 people on board. Mullin said the single-engine landing went smoothly.

title: U.S. Mint puts golden $1 coin with Trump’s image into circulation
description: The coins, meant to mark America’s 250th birthday, will also be sold on the Mint website at markups spanning roughly 50 percent to nearly 150 percent over their face value.

title: El-Sayed blames Trump for global bond market sell-off
description: Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed blamed “Trump’s mismanagement” for a global sell-off in bonds in this week.

title: Senate Majority Leader John Thune warns Republicans could lose the Senate
description: Democrats have grown more optimistic about their chances as President Donald Trump’s approval rating has declined.

title: What to know about Abdul El-Sayed
description: Democrats’ most controversial Senate candidate is in a must-win race for the party.

title: Orlando held a fight in its city-owned arena. Then came the Nazi salutes.
description: Organizers booked a kickboxer who served time in federal prison, after prosecutors said he pushed a “race-based civil war,” to fight a Jewish opponent.

title: Chevron makes its own deal to double Venezuelan production
description: The major oil company has plans to invest $7 billion as Trump aligns with its largest competitor in Venezuela.

title: Watch Ontario, New York, residents sound off on the Lake America name change
description: In a Trump-voting town named after Lake Ontario, residents have strong feelings about the president rechristening it to Lake America.

title: Takeaways from Massachusetts, where generational challenges fizzled
description: With the primary season winding down, the anti-incumbent wave spared older Democrats including Sen. Edward Markey, 80, who held off younger challengers.

title: Iran retaliates with missiles and drones, defying Trump’s warning
description: President Donald Trump had warned after Tuesday's U.S. strikes that any retaliation would see Iran “hit again at a much harder and higher level.”

title: Democrats’ battle over establishment figures heads to New Hampshire
description: After Massachusetts Sen. Ed Markey triumphed in the Democratic Senate primary, it's off to the Granite State.

title: Using legal loopholes and executive power, Trump is remaking Washington
description: The president has spent his second term in office testing — and often proving — the claim that no one could stop his construction agenda.

title: These activists plan to stand up to federal agents if they show up at the polls
description: The administration hasn’t ruled out having federal agents at polls. The Vote Safe project plans to send observers to precincts in four battleground states.

title: Thanks to Lake Ontario, MapQuest is popular all over again
description: As of Tuesday, the 30-year-old navigation tool was Apple’s No. 1 free app after the company rebuffed an executive order renaming the Great Lake.

title: Poll shows nearly 90% of Americans believe government corruption is widespread
description: Americans have the highest level of distrust in their government in two decades, voicing bipartisan frustration with the country’s institutions and the people who run them.

title: How will tariffs affect the midterms? In this Michigan border town, it's complicated
description: The recent trade war between the U.S. and Canada has both economic and political implications for Michigan, given it's the state's top trade partner.

title: Whistleblower's lawyer warns USPS plan for Trump's order could keep ballots from voters
description: A lawyer for an anonymous whistleblower says Postal Service plans for an unusual verification rule, combined with a hastily built online system, could delay mail ballots from reaching eligible voters.

title: Trump attempts to combat high gas prices as affordability crisis looms over midterms
description: President Trump seems to be pulling out all the stops to mitigate high gas prices ahead of the midterms.

title: Political consultant on how the cost-of-living is affecting Trump's approval rating
description: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with political consultant Sarah Longwell about Trump's low approval rating and high gas prices, as affordability shadows the approaching midterm election.

title: Trump says he’ll nominate Hung Cao as Navy secretary
description: The Vietnamese refugee, Navy veteran and former Virginia political candidate has been leading the service on an acting basis.

title: Man accused of killing Charlie Kirk will stand trial, face potential death penalty
description: Tyler James Robinson, the 23-year-old accused of fatally shooting Charlie Kirk, pleaded not guilty to murder charges.

title: Postal Service plans may keep voters from getting ballots, whistleblower says
description: An anonymous federal official warns that a rushed USPS portal tied to Trump’s mail-voting order could reject large batches of ballots before the midterms.

title: House GOP censures one of its own over conduct with female staffers
description: Rep. Chuck Edwards was censured by his colleagues in the House over his conduct with female staffers.

title: ‘We flat have to win there’: Thune urges Trump to help in Texas Senate race
description: Democratic state Rep. James Talarico is locked in a tight race with the Republican nominee.

title: American sentenced to 2 years for working as Chinese intelligence asset
description: Thomas W. Pauken II developed sources with access to sensitive information in the U.S. and was told his reports were being sent directly to China’s president, according to court records.

title: Incumbent Sen. Ed Markey wins Massachusetts' Democratic primary for U.S. Senate
description: Bucking a push for younger leadership this election season, Sen. Ed Markey, 80, won the Democratic nomination against Rep. Seth Moulton, 47, who said that his party needed new leaders.

title: Jury in Lindsay Clancy trial is deadlocked, will continue deliberations
description: The jurors have spent four days discussing the mental state of Clancy, who has admitted killing her children. The judge told them to keep working to reach a verdict.

title: The U.S.’s many foreign entanglements under Trump
description: Iran, Ukraine and Venezuela top the list.

title: North Carolina Rep. Chuck Edwards is formally censured over harassment allegations
description: The censure vote drew bipartisan support, and followed an investigation by the House Ethics Committee into allegations of sexual harassment against two young female staff members.

title: Trump urges Congress to pass tax incentives to restore Hollywood’s luster
description: The loss of film and TV production to other countries ‘is hurting California very badly,’ the president said.

title: Vance wades into caustic Michigan Senate race, calling candidate ‘evil’
description: The vice president called Democratic nominee Abdul El-Sayed “very, very evil” and told him to stop talking about Vance’s wife.
